-"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" **Main program check** — compares the installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh` against the npm latest (full pac"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"kument, **stable-first**, semver-aware). A pre-release target is installed only when it belongs to t"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"he channel the deployment already follows — a cross-channel promotion (`rc` → `alpha`) is refused wi"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"th `E_PRERELEASE` unless you enable the `allowPrerelease` setting, so the checker never promotes the"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" harness into an unintended pre-release channel.
- **Third-party plugin check** — scans installed no"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"n-official plugins (layout-agnostic, incl. pnpm-hoisted `node_modules`), cross-compares each against"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" **npm + GitHub** (target = higher version); local tools with no publish source go to `ignored`. Whe"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"n a plugin name has multiple copies, the one in the **composition-owning profile's `node_modules`** "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"wins (the rest are listed as `copies`), and each plugin can be excluded from prompts (`excludedPlugi"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ns`, re-enableable in the settings page).
- **Working GitHub channel** — dedicated HTTPS client for "},{"id":"p6s12","text":"GitHub domains (tolerates self-signed local proxies; the npm registry still uses strict TLS), with r"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"edirects, size caps and timeouts; codeload tarballs are validated before install.
- **In-GUI banner*"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"* — locale-aware (zh/en follows the DSH UI language), states update / up-to-date / failure, with a s"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"uppression flag and a **change brief** (vX→vY + risk level + release notes when available).

Both check on page load"},{"id":"p8s6","text":", then every 6 hours; the settings page ("检查更新") adds rollback buttons."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install & mount"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The package is a profile bundle (its manifest declares `dsh.bundle.patch`)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### dsh `0.1.6-alpha.2` and later: the profile needs its own link"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Step 1 alone is **no longer enough**. `0.1.6-alpha.2` changed the profile module-resolution

- **`$DSH_HOME`** — the parent of the `profiles` root (state, backups, restart log"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" live there).
